description: Ensure users can sort products by popularity through the sorting dropdown.
steps: Select the 'Sort by popularity' option from the dropdown.
Wait for the products list to refresh.
Verify that products are sorted based on popularity rankings.

selectors.text:
Default sorting
Sort by popularity
Sort by average rating
Sort by latest
Sort by price: low to high
Sort by price: high to low

expected_results: Products are displayed in descending order of popularity.
Sorting updates the product list dynamically.
edge_cases: Dropdown menu does not display sorting options.
User selects an invalid option from the dropdown.
Products have equal popularity scores, causing ambiguity.
Backend fails to fetch popularity data.
data_requirements: Products with popularity scores defined in the backend.
Valid sorting options populated in the dropdown.
Backend logic to handle popularity-based sorting.
dependencies: Sorting functionality must be implemented in the backend.
Popularity data for products must be accurate.
api_interactions: API call to fetch sorted product data.
Error handling for invalid sorting criteria.
performance_metrics: Dropdown menu interaction latency should be minimal.
Sorting response time should be under 2 seconds.
accessibility_requirements: Dropdown options must be accessible via keyboard navigation.
Ensure the selected option is announced by screen readers.
